text_block_list.text:
One day, Директор Акикава makes a
sudden
announcement about the
Summer Sprint Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She says something good might happen
if Curren
can place well in the Summer
Sprints. Considering
her schedule, I
suggest three races...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Hakodate Sprint Stakes in late June,
the
Keeneland Cup in late August, and
the Centaur
Stakes in late September.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It isn't mandatory, so Каррен Тян says
that it's
up to me whether we take them
on. Looks like I
have some thinking to
do...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
